propositions: Add an advisory LLM criterion that judges whether a ticket declaring no repository-file impact actually requires repository-file changes, routed deterministically only when file_impact_scope is exactly 'none'.
Extend the routing validator to accept require_file_impact_scope lists and update registry.applies() to filter by file_impact_scope membership, failing closed for missing/None/unknown values.
Carry persisted no_file_impact_reason into Pass-1 via compositional extra_parts, serializing it as deterministic JSON so quotes, newlines, and Unicode round-trip unchanged through the LLM request.

The criterion must use three sub-answer fields (assertion_plausible, reason_grounded, repo_file_change_named) to decide: pass when external-only with grounded reason, advisory contradiction when repository edit required, and non-blocking coaching when insufficient evidence.
Generate and maintain the criterion documentation in docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md via repository tooling, verified idempotent across regenerations without hand-editing.

All acceptance criteria, tests, and CI gates must use observable behavior and public contracts (routing config, LLM request payload, CLI explain, verdict aggregation) rather than source-text or private-implementation assertions.
